    <div style="text-align: center;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><u>SCHEDULE 13D</u></font></font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: left;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">Item 1.&#160; Security and Issuer</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">This Schedule&#160;13D relates to Ordinary Shares of Bicycle Therapeutics Limited, a limited&#160; company organized under the laws of England and Wales (the
        &#8220;Issuer&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;).&#160;&#160;The address of the principal executive offices of the Issuer is N900, Babraham Research Campus, Cambridge CB22 3AT, United Kingdom.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: left;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">Item 2.&#160; Identity and Background</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(a)&#160;This Schedule&#160;13D is being filed on behalf of Tybourne Capital Management (HK) Limited (&#8220;Tybourne HK&#8221;), Tybourne Capital Management Limited (&#8220;Tybourne
        Cayman&#8221;), Tybourne Kesari Limited (&#8220;Tybourne Kesari&#8221;), Viswanathan Krishnan and Aquila Investments IV (together, the &#8220;Reporting Persons&#8221;).&#160;&#160;The securities reported herein are beneficially owned by Tybourne HK in its capacity as investment advisor
        to </font><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Aquila Investments IV, other </font>private investment funds and accounts.&#160; Tybourne Cayman is the parent of
        Tybourne HK.&#160; Tybourne Kesari is the parent of Tybourne Cayman.&#160; Mr. Krishnan is the principal and sole shareholder of Tybourne Kesari.&#160; Each of the Reporting Persons disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares reported herein except to the extent
        of its pecuniary interest in such shares, and the inclusion of such securities in this report shall not be deemed an admission of beneficial ownership for any purpose.</font></div>
    <div style="text-align: left;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#160;</font></div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(b)&#160;The business address of each of the Reporting Persons is c/o Tybourne Capital Management (HK) Limited, 30/F, AIA Central, 1 Connaught Road Central,
        Hong Kong, K3<font style="font-size: 8pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">.</font></font></div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#160;</font></div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(c)&#160;See Item 2(a).</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(d) None of the Reporting Persons has, during the last five years, been convicted in a criminal proceeding (excluding traffic violations or similar
        misdemeanors).</font></div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#160;</font></div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(e)&#160;None of the Reporting Persons has, during the last five years, been a party to a civil proceeding of a judicial or administrative body of competent
        jurisdiction and as a result of such proceeding was or is subject to a judgment, decree or final order enjoining future violations of, or prohibiting or mandating activities subject to, federal or State securities laws or finding any violation with
        respect to such laws.</font></div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#160;</font></div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(f)&#160;See Item 6 of the respective cover page of each Reporting Person</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: left;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">Item 3.&#160; Source and Amount of Funds or Other Consideration</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">The Ordinary Shares reported herein as being beneficially owned by the Reporting Persons were purchased using working capital of </font><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Aquila Investments IV and other </font></font> private
        investment funds and accounts for which Tybourne HK serves as investment advisor.&#160; The aggregate consideration paid for such securities was approximately $25,310,000.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: left;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">Item 4.&#160; Purpose of Transaction</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">The Reporting Persons acquired the securities reported herein for the benefit of the above-referenced private investment funds and accounts for investment
        purposes.&#160; The Reporting Persons intend to evaluate this investment in the Issuer and options with respect to such investment on an ongoing basis.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">The Reporting Persons may acquire additional Ordinary Shares and/or other securities of the Issuer from time to time or may dispose of any or all of such
        Ordinary Shares or other securities held or beneficially owned by them at any time.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">From time to time, the Reporting Persons may engage in discussions with the Issuer&#8217;s Board of Directors and/or members of the Issuer&#8217;s management team
        concerning, without limitation, potential business combinations and strategic alternatives, the business, operations, capital structure, governance, management, strategy of the Issuer and other matters concerning the Issuer.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: left;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">The Reporting Persons reserve the right to change their purpose and to formulate and implement plans or proposals with respect to the Issuer at any time and
        from time to time.&#160; Any such action may be made by the Reporting Persons alone or in conjunction with other shareholders, potential acquirers, financing sources and/or other third parties and could include one or more purposes, plans or proposals
        that relate to or would result in actions required to be reported herein in accordance with Item 4 of Schedule 13D.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Bosun Hau, who serves as Managing Director and Principal &#8211; Private Markets at Tybourne HK, is a Director of the Issuer.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: left;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">Item 5.&#160; Interest in Securities of the Issuer</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(a) and (b)&#160; See Items 7-13 of the cover pages and Item 2 above.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">The percentage calculations herein are based upon the statement in a prospectus dated May 22, 2019, as filed by the Issuer with the Securities and Exchange
        Commission on May 23, 2019, that there would be 17,696,417 Ordinary Shares of the Issuer outstanding as of the closing of the public offering to which such prospectus related.</font></div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">(c)&#160; The Reporting Persons did not engage in any transactions in </font><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Ordinary Shares </font>of the Issuer during the sixty day period prior to the filing of this Schedule 13D other than (i) the exercise of a warrant to acquire 139,264 </font><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><font style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Ordinary Shares at an exercise price of GBP 0.01 per share immediately prior to the closing of the Issuer's initial public
          offering on May 28, 2019 and (ii)</font> the purchase of 364,286 Ordinary Shares in such public offering at a price of $14.00 per share.</font></div>
